fingerprint_definition: sha256(GazeAudit-style canonical JSON of the protocol object: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity)

requirements: Round 1 Session 1 FXS and TEX recordings are both present
timestamps are finite and strictly increasing within each recording
EyeLink real-time parser labels are available for both recordings
at least one EyeLink-parser fixation event is recoverable in each task

coordinate_conversion.method: pymovements deg2pix using GazeBase screen geometry

detector_space.algorithm_specific_parameters: pEYES 0.2.2 defaults; fully resolved parameter dictionaries must be recorded before endpoint aggregation and bound into the execution manifest

missingness.primary_policy: preserve NaN gaze samples; no interpolation
missingness.reference_nonfixation_policy: EyeLink blink, saccade, invalid, and unlabeled samples are not fixations
missingness.detector_missing_summary_policy: do not impute missing participant-task summaries

endpoint.name: median_within_participant_fixation_duration_contrast_ms
endpoint.event_definition: maximal contiguous runs of samples labelled fixation

reference.source: EyeLink real-time parser labels distributed with GazeBase
reference.reference_effect: same endpoint computed from EyeLink parser labels
reference.zero_effect_guardrail: if the reference effect is exactly zero, stop before alternative-detector endpoint inspection and version a new rule because relative error is undefined

completeness_gate.failure_action: case study is incomplete and must not receive a robust/fragile classification; detector is not silently dropped

interpretation.robust_means: at least six of seven predeclared detector specifications recover the external-reference conclusion within the declared 20% relative-error tolerance and direction, after every detector passes the completeness gate
interpretation.scope_limit: classification applies only to this predeclared dataset, cohort, tasks, endpoint, detector space, software versions, and rule
